messages:
maya: Heads-up — hitting JSON-mode parsing failures in the starter kit sampleapp during an auth retry. Stacktrace below, repro steps included. Anyone seen this? cc @sam @oliver

sam: Ugh, yeah saw a quick note about a similar failure in staging yesterday. Can you paste the request/response / logs?

oliver: Repro steps I used: 
1) enable `json_mode` in JS SDK sampleapp
2) make a function/tool call that triggers a 401 (force token refresh) while the request is in-flight
3) SDK retry re-sends the body but it looks double-encoded -> server chokes with JSON parse error. Logs: 
```
REQUEST HEADERS: content-type: application/json
REQUEST BODY: "{\"name\":\"do_thing\",\"args\":\"{\\\"id\\\":123}\\\"}"
RESPONSE: 400 Bad Request - parse error: Unexpected token \" in JSON at position 0
```

maya: here's the minimal snippet from the sampleapp retry wrapper (JS):
```
// naive retry wrapper
async function sendToolCall(payload) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  return fetch(API_URL, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body), headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} });
}
```
-> notice the accidental `JSON.stringify(body)` on retry path. When `json_mode=true` the SDK already serializes structured outputs and expects raw objects. On retry we ended up stringifying a string.

eva: That matches what I was thinking — retry logic is blindly re-serializing. Two quick notes: 1) the SDK helper should be aware of `json_mode` / structured payloads and avoid double-stringify, 2) add an integration test that forces auth refresh during a fncall so we don't regress.

sam: Short-term mitigation for customers: set env var `SDK_JSON_MODE=false` in starter kit or patch retry config in app: `retry: { serializeRequests: false }` until we ship a patch.

ci-bot: CI failing test: devex/sdk-tests › test-toolcall-json-retry (flaky) — opened ticket #DEVEX-4321.

oliver: I'll open a PR to guard the retry path and add the test. Plan: detect if body is already a stringified JSON (or check config.json_mode) and skip stringify; add a unit + e2e that simulates 401 during an in-flight fncall.

maya: This caused a customer P0 yesterday (onboarding flow). Can we also surface a short note in the starter kit README / quickstart so new users won't hit it?

sam: Yep — I'll prod release team for a patch release. If PR is small we can aim for a patch (0.8.x) by EOD. :thumbsup:

eva: I'll add a short entry in the DX troubleshooting doc: "If you see Unexpected token \" when using json_mode, check retry serialization." (reacted with :eyes:)

maya: thanks all — assigning follow-ups: oliver (PR + tests), sam (patch release), eva (DOC).

oliver: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/518 (draft) — adds guard and test. Will request review.

sam: Noted. I'll add a quick hotfix changelog blurb once PR lands.

maya: closing loop here once PR merged. Thanks!
